```{r}
#| label: fig-emp-mcpr-loss-opening-mos
#| fig-width: 16
#| fig-height: 6
#| out.height: "75%"
#| fig-pos: "htbp"
#| fig-cap: "Empirical public-health trade-off between relative mCPR loss and opening months of stock across replenishment policies."

frontier_mcpr <- plot_df_emp_inv |>
  group_by(policy) |>
  mutate(
    frontier = !purrr::map_lgl(
      seq_len(n()),
      ~ any(
        opening_mos <= opening_mos[.x] &
          mcpr_loss <= mcpr_loss[.x] &
          (
            opening_mos < opening_mos[.x] |
              mcpr_loss < mcpr_loss[.x]
          ),
        na.rm = TRUE
      )
    )
  ) |>
  ungroup()

frontier_mcpr_path <- frontier_mcpr |>
  filter(frontier) |>
  arrange(policy, opening_mos, mcpr_loss)

ggplot(frontier_mcpr, aes(x = opening_mos, y = mcpr_loss)) +
  geom_hline(
    yintercept = 0,
    colour = "grey65",
    linetype = "dashed",
    linewidth = 0.35
  ) +
  geom_path(
    data = frontier_mcpr_path,
    aes(group = policy),
    colour = "black",
    linewidth = 0.35,
    linetype = "dashed"
  ) +
  geom_point(aes(colour = model, shape = model), size = 3, stroke = 1, alpha = 0.9) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = model_colour_values) +
  scale_shape_manual(values = model_shape_values) +
  facet_wrap(~policy, ncol = 4, scales = "free") +
  labs(
    x = "Opening months of stock",
    y = "Relative mCPR loss",
    colour = "Method",
    shape = "Method"
  ) +
  guides(
    colour = guide_legend(order = 1),
    shape = guide_legend(order = 1)
  ) +
  plot_theme
```
